title: 失败/取消后立即重新执行的恢复测试
summary: 任务系统必须证明失败和取消不是终局污染：旧下载、旧 metadata、disabled state、临时 runtime 状态都应清理，紧接着的新任务能成功且不继承旧任务语义。
scenarios: invalid input -> actionable failure -> primary action re-enabled -> no stale output -> corrected input succeeds
active task -> cancel -> no stale output -> immediate new task succeeds
successful task A -> successful task B -> output B contains no task-A metadata
main input switch -> scanned state/attachments/track plan from previous input are invalidated
invariants: No stale downloadable output is exposed after failure/cancel.
The next task is runnable without page/app restart.
Task-specific metadata and scanned state do not leak across task identity changes.
